reviews.text:
A wonderful experience! 🐈‍⬛❤️
My little star needs special care due to her mobility difficulties, and she couldn't have been in better hands.

I found extraordinary affection, dedication, and sensitivity at Olá Amigo. I always received news, photos, and videos that gave me enormous peace of mind.

It was moving to see her so well cared for and with so much attention.

I leave my sincere thanks for all the love and dedication. Because caring for an animal is much more than a responsibility: it's also about caring with your heart.

I recommend them without any hesitation! ❤️🐾
The owner is an amazing person, and so are the people who work there! My kitten was very well cared for, and I received updates on him every day ❤️ The space is large and has everything a cat needs.

We wanted to thank Elena immensely for the incredible way she took care of our little boy during our vacation. She was always very careful, caring, and patient, giving us a lot of confidence and peace of mind.
It was the first time we left him at a hotel, and we couldn't have been happier with the experience. From the first moment, we felt he was in good hands, and that made all the difference for us.
Without a doubt, Elena will be a reference for us in the future, whenever we need her again. We wholeheartedly recommend her! 💖

Our elderly cat stayed here for two weeks. I really appreciated the daily pictures and updates! Our cat seemed to love Elena and was really well cared for. They obviously love cats and care a lot! I’ll definitely bring her here again!

Amazing place where my furry babies were very well taken care of. I was worried because my cat has diabetes, but everything went beautifully! They didn't even want to leave after almost a month's stay! Elena is extraordinary ☺️ Thank you for the care! 🥰 …

Thank you!!

I left my cat there for 9 days and I feel she was treated with care and affection.

Elena took care to send photos and videos daily, showing me how my cat was adapting and reacting to the hotel.

My cat is normal, happy and healthy.

I will use their services again.
Care, affection, rigor, professionalism; in a word: trust.

We have been taking our cat to Elena's place for a year now, and it's been a great experience every time. This is a calm and loving environment where the wellbeing of the cats are in focus. We are very happy to have found "Ola, Amigo!" and can recommend this hotel to everyone :)

I've left my kitten there countless times and she's treated super well and they're very friendly.
Every day they sent me photos and videos and put my mind at ease.
And I will leave them there again many times.

I recommend them 100%.
Thank you ❤️❤️

A very friendly Russian couple living in Portugal, who love cats and have a space prepared to welcome these pets. Everything went well. During our trip we received photos and videos to keep us updated. Highly recommended!

I left my Persian cat at the "Ola Amigo" hotel for a week and was very satisfied with the care and attention Elena gave her. Being a Persian cat, she requires some specific care, which Elena immediately offered to provide, and I received photos or videos every day that reassured me a lot. I also greatly appreciated Elena's availability from day one, when I had some unforeseen issues with my travel dates, always focusing on solutions and the client's needs. The space is very welcoming, and Elena definitely makes a difference. I highly recommend her and will use her services again when needed. Thank you <3

Yesterday we picked up our 8 year old tabby Savannah from her first stay at Olá Amigo Cat Hotel. We're so impressed with Elena and the atmosphere she creates for the cats, which is interactive, thoughtful and rooted in love. You can see how much she cares for the animals, and she gets to know their needs and temperaments on a very personal level. We were extremely uneasy about leaving our spicy girl in a new location for 7 nights, but Elena continually kept us informed of her mood, behaviors and eating habits. As a cat who has not been socialized with other cats since she was very young, I was happy to see that Elena was very cautious and watchful. Savannah did eventually get up the bravery to leave her space a few times, but spent most of her time in her dedicated room which looked spacious, comfy and clean. Even so, Elena still gave her plenty of attention and care, and Savvy came home in a happy and relaxed mood. I will certainly trust her in Elena's care again for future trips and will recommend Olá Amigo to others.

I left my 4-month-old kitten with Elena for 8 days. She sent me photos and videos every day, was always available to answer any questions, and the kitten came back in great shape.

I recommend her to everyone.
A welcoming place, Elena is very attentive and available to the cats. I received photos, videos, and reports every day. A hotel to recommend for anyone who has a cat.
Elena is amazing! She took great care of our cats. During our vacation, we heard from them every day. Our cats came home happy.

My cat has been staying at this hotel ever since I'm on vacation, and so far I only have good things to say.
The lady who takes care of him sends me photos and videos every day, and from what I see, the treatment is 5 stars.
Cat's name: Charlie
My Simão Nhatelo

We were heartbroken for almost 15 days while our Oliver was away from us for the first time. It was spectacular, from the first contact to the daily updates with photos and videos. We're even thinking about going back occasionally just to see friends. I highly recommend it 💚💚 …

We left our Toulouse at the hotel for 10 days. We were very nervous at first, but Elena did everything she could to reassure us and instill confidence. She sent us photos and videos every day and kept us updated on his condition. Toulouse made friends there and had a great time. We were pleased that our requests were taken into account and that they checked the cat's documents and vaccinations before check-in. Thanks to the hotel and especially to Elena, we now have a place where we can safely leave our cat during our vacations.
Excellent! My cat stayed for 28 days, and the owner sent real-time photos or videos of the cat every morning and evening, and even played with the cat. I felt very reassured and at ease!

My cat stayed at the hotel for a two week period. Elena made an outstanding work in taking care for a little nice cat that never had contact with other cats. Apart for the great care (we received always two contacts - photos or videos and a comment - per day), Elena managed to transform a very suspicious and fearful kitten into a more confident and sociable animal. Fantastic work, thank you Elena!

My cat stayed at the hotel 8 nights,Elena sent me videos and photos 2x per day. Cats have the chance to go out and play in the common play area but my animal gets extremely stressed outside home,probably of the smell of other pets,so I warned Elena about this. We left his carrier(and his basket ) in his room,where he slept most of the time. Thank you Elena for being so caring and for all your patience with this silly stressed cat!

**⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️ 5/5 – Exceptional Care for My Beloved Cat!**

I cannot recommend Ola Amigo enough! Leaving my cat for three weeks was incredibly stressful for me, but the owner, Senhora Elena, went above and beyond to ensure my fur baby was happy, safe, and loved.

From the moment I dropped her off, I knew she was in great hands.Senhora Elena provided daily updates with photos and videos, which gave me so much peace of mind. My cat can be shy, but she warmed up quickly thanks to the calm, affectionate environment.

The facility was clean, cozy, and filled with enrichment—cat tree, toys, and even a sunny window perch for bird-watching! They followed my care instructions perfectly, including her special diet and playtime routine.

When I picked her up, she was relaxed, healthy, and clearly well cared for. Senhora Elena even gave me a Photo card! such a sweet touch!

Thank you for treating my cat like family! 🐾💖

*Wajdi, Amira and Pokita*

My kitten's stay at the cat hotel was simply 5 stars! I felt so relieved knowing he was in good hands. Elena was amazing – she sent photos and videos every day, which put me much more at ease. You can see that they treat the kittens with a lot of love and dedication. I recommend it without hesitation!

We left our cat there for a week and were absolutely delighted!! Elena is a true professional. She sent photos and videos every morning and evening and answered all our questions very quickly. We recommend this hotel to all our friends. The price/quality ratio is excellent. From now on, we will always leave our cat only at this hotel. Thank you very much again.

We left our cat with us for 10 days, and everything went perfectly. All our requests were heard and respected, the cat was surrounded by care and attention, and everyone was happy!
Thank you so much to Elena, we're glad we had someone to trust with our cat during our trip! :)

Due to health reasons, we had to travel to another country for medical treatment and, unfortunately, we couldn't take our cat with us. Luckily, he was in excellent hands here. We sincerely thank the team for the care, responsibility, and affection they showed throughout our stay. 😊😊😊 …
What a wonderful hotel! It's clear that the cats are truly loved and cared for. Elena sent photos and made our kitty's stay as comfortable as possible. Thank you!

My husband and I left our cats at this hotel from May 29th to June 1st. We loved everything: quick and easy communication with the owner, Elena, photo reports and videos of the cats' day, cleanliness, lots of toys—the cats loved it.
Guigui had a super fun week with new friends. The lady is responsible and very loving with the kittens. We received photos and videos of Guigui every day. Thank you so much, we'll be back soon! 🥰❤️ …

This place is simply amazing! We left our cat there for 10 days. It's a very friendly and comfortable environment for cats, everything is safe, and we were in constant contact with the owners, receiving videos and photos regularly. I highly recommend it; it's the best hotel we've ever stayed at with our cat!

We left our cat for two weeks.
Twice a day, we received messages and photos of how our Phobos was spending his time.
The hotel provides each cat with a separate "room," but during the day, cats who are willing to socialize are free to roam the hotel grounds under supervision.
A huge thank you to Elena and all the hotel staff for caring for our beloved pet!

Amazing place for beloved cats. Our Risya spent great time with Elena and her team. With best atmosphere, high-quality care and super loving, friendly environment.
Strongly recommended place. We’ll be there again, for sure!

We left our cat Vasya in a foster home for seven days for the first time, and we were very pleased!
Elena is very attentive and caring. It's immediately obvious that she loves animals and knows how to handle them.
Every day, they sent us photos and videos and told us how our cat was doing, which was very reassuring. The conditions for the animals are very good, with plenty of space to play and relax.
Our Vasya even made friends with other cats there, which was a big surprise for us, as we thought he was afraid of other cats. But thanks to Elena, we realized that was not the case at all.
Our cat returned home calm and well-cared for, stress-free.
Thank you for your care! Now we know exactly where to go next time.

We abandoned our cat several times. The first time, we were a little nervous, as friends had always helped us out before, but everything was fine. We've abandoned him three times now, and everything is great. It's clear the owners love their animals; it's palpable.

This was our first time fostering a cat, and we were nervous because he has a difficult personality (and is also anxious). But everything went great. Elena treated him like her own, and was very attentive and empathetic. He didn't want to leave, and during his stay, he took some great photos. I highly recommend her 👍🏻 …

The owner was very welcoming and took good care of the cat, sending photos every day. She followed all the care instructions. The cat seemed quite happy.

But a week and a half after the cat returned home, a fungal infection was discovered on his ear. Fortunately, it wasn't ringworm, but microsporia, but treatment also requires time and effort. I can't say for sure that it was a consequence of his stay at the hotel. But this was the first time the cat had encountered this problem after visiting the hotel.
And what reinforces my concerns is that the animals at this hotel not only roam the common area but can also interact with each other. Despite the hotel's friendly atmosphere, I'm now afraid to leave my cat there.

We left our shy cat at this hotel for six days, and I was amazed at how quickly the staff gained her trust. Thanks to their patience and care, she felt comfortable and relaxed. The daily photo and video updates were reassuring, and she came home calm and happy. Highly recommend this place for anyone looking for a caring cat hotel!

We stayed our cat at the hotel for a week. He had a great time and made new friends. Now I guess I'll have to get another cat. 🙂 The rooms are very spacious compared to other hotels, and there's a large play area. The cats roam around together, and the hotel only accepts neutered and vaccinated cats. It's nice that the staff cares about the pets' safety.

Left my kitty for 2 days and I was really happy with the service! Elena is amazing and she cares about the cats and their well being! I felt secure leaving him in good hands, she was updating me with photos and videos,  so I felt reassured its all good! 🤎 …

We were going away for a week and needed to leave our cat with someone (we'd never done that before), but everything went well! The cat adapted well and was doing well! Daily photo reports and behavioral descriptions from the cat hotel owners helped us monitor and stay informed. We're very happy, we're planning future trips and know where we can leave our cat in good hands. 🐱

A huge thank you to the staff at "Olá, amigo!" Our cat spent a week there, and we received photos twice a day the entire time, showing that he was completely happy, comfortable, and safe. We'll definitely be back again; it's so wonderful to have a place where we can leave a family member without worrying about them ♥️
I left my cat for 4 days in this hotel and now I can recommend it to everyone. They love cats and they are very responsible.

We left our cat at this hotel for 5 days, and we were very happy with the care provided. The staff took great care of our pet, took him for walks every day, and played with him a lot. It was especially nice to receive daily photo and video …

Left my 2 cats for a moth and highly recommend the hotel! The sitters frequently sent me messages with my pets photos, keeping me updated about their wellbeing. Took them back healthy, happy and playful. Couldn’t be happier 🥰 …
